bio.text: Carmen Bucco is the Republican candidate for New Jersey's 10th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
He is a tailor who runs the business Bucco Couture and is a former Belleville school board member.
He lost to Rep. LaMonica McIver in the September 2024 special election and the November 2024 general election for the same seat, and ran for the State Assembly in the 20th District in 2025.

sources.title: Undaunted by losses, Carmen Bucco will run for NJ-10 once again
